evidence.title: Design in Claude Code (without the AI look)

name: How to quit AI slop
summary: Paid newsletter post on making Claude Code design on brand with a DESIGN.md, five brand rules and an examples folder.
description: Charlie Hills' walkthrough of building a design system for AI: pointing Claude at an existing Figma deck through the Figma MCP, pulling the rules out of work that already exists, and keeping them in one reference file, a DESIGN.md and an examples folder. The first two parts are readable free; the rest needs a paid subscription.
contains: free preview of the first two parts
four files: brand rules, DESIGN.md, examples folder, prompts
